title: Reservation system for small restaurants
summary: Cheap, simple booking software for independent restaurants.
whyTempting: Big booking platforms are expensive for small venues.
whyItFails: Restaurants are low-margin customers. Churn and closures are frequent. Sales cost. Selling to individual restaurants is expensive. Bundled by POS providers. POS systems add booking for free.
whatWouldChange: Distribution through a POS or supplier channel that already reaches restaurants.

attempts.outcome: Closing its booking platform by the end of 2026

reasons.detail: Restaurants are low-margin customers: Churn and closures are frequent.
Sales cost: Selling to individual restaurants is expensive.
Bundled by POS providers: POS systems add booking for free.
